task: Research and select a 3D object library format (e.g., glTF, FBX) and define how assets will be sourced/created for the predefined library (e.g., custom modeling vs. open-source repositories).
Evaluate and choose a web-based 3D rendering framework (e.g., Three.js, Babylon.js) for the object placement system and document this in the tech stack.
Design a prototype for the networked viewing feature by researching multiplayer synchronization solutions (e.g., WebSockets with Socket.io, WebRTC).
Create a preliminary usability testing plan with metrics (e.g., time-to-place-object, error rates) to validate the intuitiveness of the controls.
